retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, gritty portrait of a man in a cowboy hat with heavy shadow play and a cross-hatched distressed overlay.

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium close-up portrait of a man wearing a straw cowboy hat and leather jacket, characterized by deep shadows obscuring half the face, set against a desaturated rural background with a heavy cross-hatched texture overlay.
coreVisualRelationships: High contrast between the shadowed face and the bright sky
Textural harmony between the leather jacket and the distressed overlay
Subject offset to the left to balance right-aligned typography
Desaturated palette unifying the subject and the background
coreInvariants: Cross-hatched scratch texture across the entire frame
Straw cowboy hat with a curved brim

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned in the left two-thirds of the frame, medium shot from the waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The visible eye and the bridge of the nose emerging from deep shadow.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the subject's gaze to the large display text on the right, then down to the secondary text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper right quadrant provides a bright, open area for text placement.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated earth tones (tan, beige, grey) in the clothing and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for shadows and high-contrast facial features.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted red and blue plaid patterns in the shirt.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast (dark shadows vs. bright sky).

letterConstructionRules: Rough, eroded edges simulating woodblock or weathered paint
characterSpecificRedesigns: Vertical distressing within the letterforms to match the overall image texture

composition.relationshipToImage: placed in the bright negative space of the sky
aligned to the right edge of the display text

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavily textured, condensed display face paired with a clean, widely-spaced geometric sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man in a straw cowboy hat and leather jacket, lit with harsh side-lighting that leaves half the face in shadow. Background should be a desaturated rural scene at dusk. Apply a heavy cross-hatched scratch texture over the entire image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in a large, white, distressed condensed sans-serif font, right-aligned in the upper right quadrant. Below it, add a subtitle in a smaller, clean, widely-spaced grey sans-serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the face partially obscured by deep shadow?
Is the cross-hatch texture visible across the whole image?
Is the text right-aligned and positioned in the sky area?
Is the color palette desaturated and gritty?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the shadow on the face
Degree of desaturation in the background
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the artist
Any brand logos or specific jewelry
Exact plaid pattern of the shirt
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the texture doesn't make the text unreadable.
Check that the shadow on the face feels intentional and dramatic.
Verify the desaturated color grading is consistent across subject and background.
Confirm the typography hierarchy is clear.
recipe.reuseFormula: Chiaroscuro Portrait + Distressed Cross-hatch + Condensed Weathered Type
